NaAudio__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index_.description: Browser import-map targets for every version-locked vendor library. Paths are relative to NaAudio__App__.html at the project root. This file is the single source of truth for the import map declared inline in the HTML shell; a browser cannot read an import map from JSON, so the two are kept in step by hand.
NaAudio__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index_.curatedDropNote: This is a CURATED drop, not a full npm package copy. Only the files AudioSPACE actually imports are vendored - see the file list below. The sibling Vale Lantern Designer vendors the complete 25 MB Three.js tree; that is right for an application that reaches into a wide range of addons over time. AudioSPACE imports exactly one addon, and this whole application has to stay servable as a static site alongside a binary audio bank, so the full tree would be most of the repository for no benefit.
NaAudio__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index_.howToExtend: To use another Three.js addon: copy it from a matching v0.184.0 checkout into examples/jsm/ keeping its path, add it to vendoredFiles below, and check its own imports - the addons import from the bare 'three' specifier and from each other by relative path, so a missing sibling fails at load with a bare 404.

vendoredFileNotes.build/three.core.js: Not imported by the application directly. three.module.js imports it by relative path, so it is not optional - without it the bare 'three' specifier resolves to a module that 404s on its own first import.
vendoredFileNotes.examples/jsm/lines/*: The fat-line addon. Not currently imported by any AudioSPACE module - NaAudio__Env3d__LineFactory uses plain LineSegments deliberately, see the note in that file. Vendored because screen-space line width is the obvious next requirement if the cables ever need to read at a fixed weight.

notInImportMap.WebAudioApi: The audio engine uses the browser's native Web Audio API and has no vendored dependency at all. That is a deliberate stance rather than an omission - see the replaceability note in NaAudio__Engine__AudioHost__.mjs, which is written so this layer can be swapped for AudioWorklets or a compiled core without touching a spatial module.
